reviewed.definition: Correct original CSV row 5 latitude to 34.5 N and row 8 longitude to 146 E from Yamamoto & Kanamatsu (2001), p.56 and coring-location maps. Preserve 7 and 6 cm confirmed by Yamamoto & Aoki (2002), Tables 1/2, p.31 and correlations p.32. Encode CSV 43 upper 10 cm; CSV 52 lower 3 cm; CSV 53 lower 6.7 cm following Table S2, retaining the primary-paper 6.5–7 cm conflict; CSV 55 lower 7 cm as a preservation sensitivity. Keep all other quantitative records and the six excluded pseudo rows. Fill S2 source references without changing row order.

coordinate_only.definition: Change the same two coordinates only, preserving all 87 original exact likelihood terms; isolates location effects.

decision_basis: Source evidence, not fitted volume. S2 vs Danhara range conflict and uncertain flow/fall records remain explicit. No published volume supplies a prior.
timing: Additional experiment declared after identifying cruise-record coordinate errors during the source audit; the earlier nine-case protocol remains unchanged.
priors: Reviewed input receives the existing baseline and all seven fixed prior sensitivities, plus a separate offset SD 1 development comparison. Both baseline and SD 1 use identical new geographic folds from revised coordinates. Coordinate-only receives the existing baseline.
